h1: 8 Best Castle District Hotels in Budapest (2026)

author_role: 8 hotels on and below Castle Hill compared on location, price per night, guest scores and parking
lead: Staying in Budapest's Castle District means waking up next to Fisherman's Bastion and Matthias Church before the tour buses arrive, and walking the empty cobbled lanes at night. The choice comes down to one question: inside the castle walls (that is Hilton Budapest, the #1 pick, €153, or three smaller hotels on the old streets) or just below the hill, cheaper and closer to the river and the metro. This page gets you to the right one in under a minute.

I compared all 8 on what decides a castle stay: how far you are from Matthias Church, the price for the same night, guest scores, parking (the old town is restricted to traffic) and the rooms, all from each hotel's live listing. Filter by inside the walls, parking or price below, or scroll straight to the ranking.

guide.h2: Before You Book: Stairs, Cars and Getting Down the Hill
guide.html:
Cars: traffic on Castle Hill is restricted; the hotels inside the walls list street parking only. If you drive, Castle Garden, Váralja Home or Carlton have garages.

Stairs: Pest-Buda's rooms are reached by stairs only, and none of the small hotels on the hill is listed as wheelchair accessible. Hilton Budapest is.

Getting around: the 16 and 116 buses run across the hill, and the funicular goes down to the Chain Bridge. From the hotels below the hill you can walk to Batthyány tér metro or cross the Chain Bridge to Pest.

Evenings: after the day visitors leave, the lanes are quiet. For a guided visit, compare the Buda Castle tours.

faqs.q: Which hotels are inside the Buda Castle walls?
faqs.a: Hilton Budapest (next to Fisherman's Bastion), Pest-Buda Design Hotel (Fortuna utca), Baltazár (Országház utca) and Buda Castle Hotel (Úri utca) are all inside the walls of the Castle District.

faqs.q: What is the best hotel in Budapest's Castle District?
faqs.a: Hilton Budapest is our #1 for its position next to Matthias Church and its Danube rooms. Baltazár has the highest guest score on the hill (9.3).

faqs.q: How much is a hotel in the Castle District?
faqs.a: From €72 (Váralja Home, just below the palace) to €153 (Hilton Budapest) for 2 adults on a March weeknight. Inside the walls, Buda Castle Hotel is the cheapest at €87.

faqs.q: Can you park in the Castle District?
faqs.a: Traffic on Castle Hill is restricted and the small hotels inside the walls list street parking only. Hilton Budapest has a garage and valet; Castle Garden, Váralja Home and Carlton, below the hill, have garages.

faqs.q: Is the Castle District a good place to stay in Budapest?
faqs.a: It is the quietest and most atmospheric area at night, but it is a bus or funicular ride from the Pest side. If you want nightlife and restaurants on your doorstep, compare the areas in our where-to-stay guide.

faqs.q: How do you get from the Castle District to the city centre?
faqs.a: Bus 16 runs from the hill across the Chain Bridge to Deák Ferenc tér. From the hotels below the hill, Batthyány tér metro or the walk over the Chain Bridge takes you to Pest.

methodology: We compared hotels on and directly below Castle Hill (District I) on what decides a castle stay: walking distance to Matthias Church and Fisherman's Bastion, the price for the same night (10 March 2027, 2 adults), the guest score and its sub-scores, parking and access, all from each hotel's live listing.
